snippet.title: Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean takes you on an epic adventure into the heart of the Caribbean. A remake of the 1999 classic, the game revives the spirit of the original while bringing modern visuals and gameplay improvements.
Take command of your ship, face enemy fleets, and set out to discover mysterious islands filled with riches. Between intense naval battles, exploration, and strategy, you will need to manage your crew, expand your fleet, and assert your dominance over the seas.

Buy the game now!
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397510/Corsairs__Battle_of_the_Caribbean/
Epic Games Store : https://store.epicgames.com/p/corsairs-da268e
GOG : https://www.gog.com/en/game/corsairs_battle_of_the_caribbean
